projects.title: CheyyarHub
projects.description: Hyper-local social network with Google Authentication, live feeds, stories, push notifications, and companion Android client.
projects.note: Hyper-local social platform connecting residents with real-time news and community updates.

caseStudy.title: Building CheyyarHub: A Community Social Network

meta.label: Key Tech
meta.value: React.js, Firebase Auth & Firestore, Cloudinary, Java

meta.label: Platforms
meta.value: Responsive Web Application & Native Android APK

caseStudy.intro: CheyyarHub was conceived to solve the lack of dedicated local communication channels in Cheyyar. Local residents previously had no single modern portal for community news, business happenings, and real-time social discussions. I developed CheyyarHub as a full-featured web and mobile platform.
caseStudy.goal: Deliver a fast, responsive, and secure hyper-local social hub supporting Google sign-in, live feed broadcasts, stories, and multimedia posts on web and Android.

blocks.heading: Hyper-local engagement at scale
blocks.body: Traditional social platforms prioritize global algorithmic trends, drowning out town-level announcements and local civic discussions. CheyyarHub is tailored exclusively around neighborhood updates, user stories, and localized interaction.

cards.title: Real-time feed sync across web & mobile
cards.body: Ensuring post updates, likes, and comment threads synchronize instantly between web browsers and Android clients.

cards.title: Optimized multimedia uploads
cards.body: Compressing and delivering user photos and stories swiftly on variable 4G/5G mobile networks.

cards.title: Seamless authentication flow
cards.body: Providing frictionless Google Authentication on both web and native Android environments.

blocks.body: Hyper-local platforms thrive when onboarding requires minimal friction and content updates deliver immediate neighborhood relevance.

blocks.label: Frontend
blocks.title: React.js & Tailwind CSS Interface
blocks.body: Constructed an intuitive, high-speed single page application with modular components, dark/light aesthetics, and fluid layout responsiveness.

blocks.label: Backend & Cloud
blocks.title: Firebase Firestore & Cloudinary Media Pipeline
blocks.body: Implemented Google OAuth, real-time Firestore listeners for feed updates, and Cloudinary CDN for automated image optimization and transformation.

blocks.label: Mobile Client
blocks.title: Native Android Companion App
blocks.body: Engineered an Android companion application in Java with Android Studio, incorporating native notifications and offline-friendly view caching.

blocks.heading: Impact & Results
blocks.body: CheyyarHub is actively deployed on Vercel and utilized by local community members.

cards.title: Production Deployment
cards.body: Deployed to high-availability infrastructure on Vercel with automated GitHub CI/CD.

cards.title: Multi-Platform Experience
cards.body: Synchronized user experience across desktop web, mobile web, and native Android devices.

projects.title: Cheyyar 3D Town
projects.description: Browser-based 3D multiplayer game of Cheyyar with iconic landmarks, drivable vehicles, collectible coins, and real-time multiplayer.
projects.note: Explorable 3D miniature town game with interactive vehicles, quests, and real-time multiplayer.

caseStudy.title: Cheyyar 3D Town (Namma Cheyyar): Browser-Based 3D Multiplayer Game

meta.label: Key Tech
meta.value: Three.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Firebase Realtime Database

caseStudy.intro: Cheyyar 3D Town (Namma Cheyyar) is an explorable 3D open-world web game inspired by the architectural heritage and iconic spots of Cheyyar town. Built to run directly in any web browser without plugins or downloads, it features interactive drivable vehicles, collectible points, and online multiplayer synchronization.
caseStudy.goal: Build an engaging, ultra-lightweight 3D miniature multiplayer exploration game accessible on mobile touchscreens and desktop browsers with 60 FPS performance.

blocks.heading: Bringing Cheyyar Town to Life in 3D
blocks.body: Modeled after the landmarks of Cheyyar—including the bus stand, Vedapureeswarar temple gopuram, and an I-MAX theatre lobby. The game immerses players into town streets where they can explore, complete community quests, and interact with fellow town residents in real time.

cards.title: Lightweight 3D rendering in browser
cards.body: Delivering smooth 60 FPS graphics and quick load times across budget mobile devices and web browsers.

cards.title: Low-latency multiplayer sync
cards.body: Synchronizing player movement coordinates, avatar states, and interactions smoothly with minimal network overhead.

cards.title: Responsive dual-touch controls
cards.body: Implementing a virtual on-screen joystick and action buttons for seamless mobile gameplay alongside keyboard WASD controls.

blocks.body: Procedural 3D modeling and efficient state synchronization deliver console-like immersion on the web with near-instant load times.

blocks.label: Town Architecture & World
blocks.title: Explorable 3D Model with Town Landmarks
blocks.body: Engineered an explorable 3D town world featuring key spots like the Cheyyar bus stand, river bridge, and I-MAX cinema lobby with interactive ticketing, box office, screens, and seating.

blocks.label: Gameplay & Mechanics
blocks.title: Drivable Vehicles & Collectible Coins
blocks.body: Programmed realistic steering physics for town share autos and buses, collectible gold coins, points system, and horn sound effects powered by the Web Audio API.

blocks.label: Multiplayer Backend
blocks.title: Firebase Realtime Database & Anonymous Auth
blocks.body: Implemented instantaneous multiplayer synchronization using Firebase Realtime Database with anonymous authentication, allowing players to see and interact with each other with zero sign-up barrier.

blocks.heading: Key Achievements
blocks.body: Shipped as a live web application deployed on Vercel with open-source code on GitHub.

cards.title: Instant Browser Play
cards.body: Zero install friction — fully playable across mobile smartphones and desktop computers via any modern browser.

cards.title: Live Multiplayer Experience
cards.body: Successfully synchronized live player sessions, chat gestures, and town exploration leaderboard points.

projects.title: CheyyarBus
projects.description: Local bus timing and route app for Cheyyar with departures board, route tracking, and voice input, shipped as Web App and Android APK.
projects.note: Public transit departures and routes tracking for regional commuters.

caseStudy.title: CheyyarBus: Digitizing Public Transit Departures

meta.label: Key Tech
meta.value: JavaScript, Firebase, Java (Android Studio), Web Speech API

caseStudy.intro: Commuters in semi-urban regions frequently struggle with unpredictable bus timetables and lack of centralized transit information. CheyyarBus delivers a live departures board, route finder, and speech recognition input to help passengers plan their journeys efficiently.
caseStudy.goal: Provide reliable, searchable departure times and stops information across regional routes connecting Cheyyar to major towns and cities.

blocks.heading: Democratizing Transit Schedules
blocks.body: Bus timings were previously scattered across physical bus station boards or word of mouth. CheyyarBus turned this data into an accessible digital tool available on any mobile phone.

cards.title: Rapid route search under low bandwidth
cards.body: Commuters checking schedules on the road need instantaneous search results without heavy payloads.

cards.title: Voice search accessibility
cards.body: Enabling commuters to speak their destination in Tamil or English to quickly locate matching departures.

cards.title: In-app update distribution
cards.body: Shipping Android APK updates directly to users with automated version checks.

blocks.label: Transit Engine
blocks.title: Real-time Timetable & Departure Calculations
blocks.body: Implemented algorithmic route matching calculating countdowns to next departures, intermediate station stops, and express versus local timings.

blocks.label: Speech Interface
blocks.title: Voice-Assisted Search
blocks.body: Integrated the Web Speech API and native Android speech recognizer for hands-free voice destination queries.

blocks.label: Native APK
blocks.title: Android Application with In-App Updater
blocks.body: Built a clean Android APK that checks Firebase version manifests on startup to notify users when new schedule updates are released.

caseStudy.title: Crafting a Hacker-Themed Developer Experience
caseStudy.intro: A distinct digital identity reflecting developer craft, system administration background, and command-line efficiency. Engineered with lightweight vanilla web standards for sub-second loading.
caseStudy.goal: Build an engaging developer showcase featuring custom animated Matrix rain, interactive skill filters, preloader animation, and responsive layout reveals.

blocks.heading: Lightweight Animation & Precision Layouts
blocks.body: By writing custom HTML5 Canvas routines instead of loading bulky 3D or heavy script libraries, the page achieves 60fps animations with minimal battery impact on mobile devices.

blocks.label: Canvas Engine
blocks.title: Matrix Digital Rain Canvas
blocks.body: Custom JavaScript rendering katakana and binary stream characters with decay fade opacity and viewport resize responsiveness.

blocks.label: UX Motion
blocks.title: Intersection Observer Scroll Reveals
blocks.body: Smooth component entrance animations utilizing the native IntersectionObserver API for zero-lag performance.
